method.bridge: P&L labor = 1.12 × gross wages − CC tips
method.tiering: week tier from actual weekly walk-in sales scaled to a normal week (tiers.json bands); template wages per open day at planning rates
method.admin_training: added at the cafe's Apr–Aug 2026 monthly average (full-month basis)
method.tips: CC tips as the cafe's Apr–Aug 2026 average share of core sales
caveats: template rates are Aug 2026 planning rates; 2025 actual labor was paid at lower rates, so the 2025 comparison understates the template's saving
reported NOI includes catering; the core-basis rows exclude catering revenue and COGS entirely
2025 core COGS % includes catering COGS in the Consolidated Model (catering-heavy months look worse than they are)

three_cafes.note: Support entities (Commissary, SRP, Cafe Mgmt, Central) net to a monthly burden in 2026; the Consolidated Model carries no 2025 support figures, so the 12-month 'after support' view uses the 2026 Jan–Aug average × 12
